meaning: Integration, technical validation and art review are independent. Unreviewed assets are not promoted by test counts.
boundaries: NPC locomotion uses a stable directional master with a cutout mesh; original independent sprite clips are retained, not claimed as repainted.
New animal sheets add feeding and lying poses; breathing is procedural. Existing product action effects remain in use.
Scenery scale and shoreline appearance change presentation, not collision footprints or saved coordinates.
The starter house retains player furnishing space; bedside rug and finer floor do not introduce invisible collision.
Real low-end devices and every avatar customization combination were not certified in this batch.
